baseline: First t per contract-token with .985<=ask<=.99, 1<=tte<=180, 0<=book_age<1000ms; existing 100ms grid
target: At least one b_orders observed 0.99 order per contract-token; no requirement that inferred decision or post timestamp exists
activity: gt_orders tx/token event rows with valid public venue print_ms; strictly print_ms+delay<t; current contract excluded
warnings: Every historical period is reused research; Oct01 is not sealed or fresh out-of-sample.
No outcome, won, PnL, future activity window, signing time or inferred decision time is read as a feature.
Venue print time is not collector receipt or on-chain wallet-attribution availability; delay0 is idealized and delays 1s/5s are sensitivity checks.
Activity scope only covers the coins/timeframes present in gt_orders, not the entire wallet or all venues.
Gross unexpired fill notional is not wallet capital, cash, margin, net inventory, or actual settlement timing.
All grid-covered inactive days stay in denominators. Missing grids, missing prints, and initial left-censoring remain coverage limitations.
A selection mask evaluates activity at first baseline eligibility; it does not wait for later activity to re-enable a contract.
Some first eligibility times follow the target order print; candidate_timing.csv makes this visible. Market-level overlap does not establish decision-time reproduction.
Calendar thresholds and chosen activity window are fitted only to design; all variants are published including losers.
No venue control is identifiable with one prediction venue (Polymarket); same/other coin activity scopes are reported instead.
Selection diagnostics make no PnL or executable performance claim.
